003.name: Rin
003.text:
I can't hear any birds or insects.
			Perhaps they are scared? Or is the mist 
			driving them away.

004.name: Rin
004.text:
This can't be good for very long. Whatever is causing
			this must be stopped!

005.text: But it's such a romantic atmosphere out!

008.text: Pretty girls such as yourself should learn to enjoy the view.

011.name: Lumia
011.text: Where are my manners, I am Lumia, a youkai.

012.name: Rin
012.text: My name is Rin Satsuki, a human.

013.name: Rin
013.text:
It's uh, nice to meet you Miss Lumia. What are you
			doing out here? It's especially dangerous oustside now.

014.name: Lumia
014.text: I'm a youkai, darling, I am not bothered by the current events.

015.name: Lumia
015.text:
You on the other hand; a cute girl like yourself 
			should not be wandering by yourself at night.

016.name: Lumia
016.text:
Perhaps you should stay at my place; i feel like it's going
			to be a looong night afterall.

017.name: Rin
017.text: Um, I think I'll pass (Where do youkai even live anyway?)

019.name: Lumia
019.text:
Still, you should go back to the village. i would hate
			for someone like you to get hurt.

020.name: Rin
020.text:
I have already decided I'm going out. Today's incident will 
			be cleared by me!

021.name: Lumia
021.text:
Don't you know humans outside the village are free
			targets for youkai?

022.name: Rin
022.text: I am aware, but that won't stop me!

024.name: Lumia
024.text: I changed my mind, I won't be letting you go home tonight.
